name: select-fallback
description: A live Miradore site fails a query it dislikes WHOLE, and reports it as a 400 carrying an <Error> envelope that names the offending entity and property -- recorded from online.miradore.com on 2026-08-26, where asking for the non-existent InvApplication.Vendor returned exactly this body. Note the body has no <?xml?> prolog and escapes its quotes, both as the live service sends them. This walks the entire attribute ladder: every rung that sends a select is refused, one group at a time, and only the last rung -- which sends no select at all -- succeeds. The path probe also sends no select, so it succeeds first and picks the endpoint. Proves an import still happens when every attribute list is rejected, that a 400 is recognised as retryable, that the description is lifted out of the envelope and logged, that the ladder degrades a group at a time rather than jumping to the core set, and that the log names the rung it ended on.
